$comment: The product prototype's sitemap, which the product designer keeps (`aidd new product-prototype`, or the prototype tool's `new-product`). It defines the navigation once: every screen draws it from here, in this order, so no two screens disagree. `navigation` lists each item's label and the <flow>:<screen> it opens; `flows` lists each flow's id (its file is flows/<id>.html) and title; `fixtures` holds the example data every screen shows through data-text and data-list. The prototype tool (`aidd prototype`) shows and checks it.
